*   **Noise at Startup:** The Monte Carlo algorithm produces objectionable noise in initial iterations.
A noise reduction filter is applied during these iterations, which increases blurring.
*   **Time Complexity:** The method is iterative and progressive.
Performance is measured in frame estimates per second.

The work built upon earlier applications of Monte Carlo integration to volume rendering by Csébfalvi et al. [27] and incorporated techniques like Woodcock tracking [31] and Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) [33].
